The resulting freeze is byte-identical to that record's own freeze output.

commands.label: install
commands.superseded_by: install-link-mode-copy (see hardlink_entanglement_incident); this original invocation used uv's Linux default --link-mode hardlink and is the root cause of the incident below. Kept here unmodified as the accurate historical record of what actually ran.

commands.label: install-link-mode-copy
commands.note: This fix round's remediation for hardlink_entanglement_incident. ${STACK_HOME}/nautilus-2.0.0rc5-r20260925 was removed and recreated (uv venv) before this install so no pre-existing hardlinked file could remain. No new PyPI network access was needed (already-warm local cache: "Resolved 5 packages in 4ms"). Raw log: ${PRIVATE_RUN_DIR}/sim/venv-relink-fix/nautilus.log.

hardlink_entanglement_incident.discovered_by: This fix round, in response to review finding 'adaptive.json:11,22,35,61 ... made adaptive-paper-r20260925 and nautilus-2.0.0rc5-r20260925 share inodes with tools/adaptive-paper-20260921'.
hardlink_entanglement_incident.note_on_which_root: This root's entanglement was with the FORBIDDEN live paper venv tools/adaptive-paper-20260921 (via the numpy/pandas/six/python-dateutil versions this install shares with that venv's package set), not with the existing_root_untouched named above (tools/nautilus-2.0.0rc5); a direct inode comparison against tools/nautilus-2.0.0rc5 found 0 shared inodes, so that root's own 'existing_root_modified: false' claim (below) was never at risk. The at-risk claim was isolation.existing_root_modified for the live venv, which this receipt did not previously mention at all.
hardlink_entanglement_incident.root_cause: The original install command above did not pass --link-mode, so uv 0.12.17's Linux default (hardlink from the shared ~/.cache/uv content-addressed cache) made this root's numpy/pandas/six/python-dateutil files hardlinks to the same cache-backed inodes already used by tools/adaptive-paper-20260921 (which installs the identical pinned versions of those four packages).

measured_before_fix.method: os.lstat st_ino comparison, nautilus-2.0.0rc5-r20260925 vs adaptive-paper-20260921 (the live venv), both lib/python3.12/site-packages trees
measured_before_fix.result: 2575 of 2593 new-root files shared an inode with the live venv.

hardlink_entanglement_incident.fix: Rebuilt nautilus-2.0.0rc5-r20260925 from scratch (uv venv, fresh directory) and reinstalled the identical package set with `uv pip install --link-mode copy`.

measured_after_fix.method: same os.lstat st_ino comparison, re-run after the copy-mode rebuild
measured_after_fix.result: 0 of 2592 new-root files share an inode with the live venv or anything outside the new root.
measured_after_fix.freeze_unchanged: Regenerated installed-freeze.txt after the rebuild: 94 bytes, sha256 9a2c65a6102be63a64f65f2c489ddcdd144bacadeee63a05b119e8e038a67f75 -- byte-identical to this receipt's originally recorded value, confirming the package set/versions are unaffected by link mode.
measured_after_fix.backtest_reconfirmed: Two fresh equity-replay confirmation runs (run-3, run-4, see evidence/artifacts/native-rollout-20260925/sim/equity-replay.json) were executed against this corrected root after the fix and both still reproduced the oracle's account.csv hashes exactly, so the relink did not change runtime behavior.

comparison_to_recorded_recipe.method: diff of sorted freeze output against native-nautilus-v2-20260920.json's recorded installed_distributions and freeze.stdout sha256
comparison_to_recorded_recipe.result: IDENTICAL package set/versions; installed-freeze.txt sha256 exactly matches the recorded freeze.stdout sha256 (9a2c65a6102be63a64f65f2c489ddcdd144bacadeee63a05b119e8e038a67f75)

isolation.network_used: PyPI package resolution/download only (https://pypi.org/simple); no Alpaca or other market-data endpoint contacted. The copy-mode rebuild needed no additional network access (already-warm local uv cache).
isolation.existing_root_modified_note: True and unaffected by the incident below: tools/nautilus-2.0.0rc5 shares 0 inodes with this new root, confirmed by direct comparison. See hardlink_entanglement_incident for a *different* root (the forbidden live paper venv tools/adaptive-paper-20260921) that this receipt did not previously disclose being entangled with at all.

limitations: Release candidate build (2.0.0rc5), not a production/live-capital acceptance.
This receipt covers environment construction only; the equity-replay backtest receipt in this same directory covers the runtime E2E acceptance on this root.

PyPI wheel hashes are trusted from the index at install time; no separate re-hash/signature verification of the downloaded wheel was performed for this build (matching the source recipe's own documented scope).

See hardlink_entanglement_incident: the original build hardlinked this root's numpy/pandas/six/python-dateutil files to the FORBIDDEN live paper venv tools/adaptive-paper-20260921 via uv's Linux default link mode -- an undisclosed scope/isolation issue in the prior round's receipt, distinct from and in addition to the adaptive-paper.json incident. Fixed this round by rebuilding with --link-mode copy (0 shared inodes verified after).
